title: demo
tagline: 211 is a Oregon non-emergency number for social services provided by the government to the homeless
description: This was made because the City of Portland is running out of money, as a result of fraud against the US government, and the US government no longer providing the state of Oregon with money. HUD (Housing and Urban Development, has advertised that 4.04 billion will go to organizations a continuum of care for the homeless, and we intent to provide a coordinated care organization using AI agents, and zero knowledge proofs, to better track the homeless and predict what interventions will better lead to recovery. https://x.com/HUDgov/status/2061563101477048746
how_its_made:
This project uses Worldcoin's IDkit and Prover kit to be able to prove that a user is actually a human, and to prove to the government that the money spent by the social services agency actually went to an eligible person, in addition to the ipfs_datasets_py formal logic theorum provers for the US law, and the knowledge graph databases, to provide transparency in spending.

This project uses chainlink to be able to use a LLM to generate reports automatically about the analytics , in conjunction with the ipfs_datasets_py graph databases and theorum provers, to make sure that all outputs by our legal reasoning engine is going to be deterministic, and the theorum provers will stop LLM hallucinations.

This project uses Sui Walrus, in leiu and in addition to the filecoin network, to store sensative PII information that is encrypted by the person, who can delegate permissions for other people to access it (e.g. a doctor, lawyer, social worker, etc), so that for limited times others can decrypt or view data e.g. photo id, insurance, etc.
auto_summary: The project combines a React World ID wallet interface with Python IPFS tooling and a Walrus-backed fsspec storage integration.
